_doc: Brand marks the image model painted onto a device, and where to take clean
pixels from to cover them. `tools.py strip-logos` reads ../ai-scenes/<in>,
applies each patch and writes ../ai-scenes/<out>; the generated scene is
never edited in place, so a patch can always be re-measured and replayed.
This is the last stage of a scene's chain: generate -> edit -> strip-logos.
Boxes come from `tools.py find-logo IMG X0 Y0 X1 Y1` (plus its padding);
`from` is the offset to the clean stretch of the same surface that gets
cloned over the box, so grain and lighting already match. Check the result
with --preview: find-logo is a locator, not a pass/fail detector, and on an
already-flat surface it just returns the window's noise.

patches.what: Apple logo on the column phone's back
